segments.en: Your AI agent writes it. The compiler checks it.
segments.tr: AI 智能体来写， 编译器来查。

segments.en: Glyph reads like TypeScript, with the escape hatches removed: no any, no casts, no unchecked data, every case handled. It compiles to readable TypeScript, so you keep node, npm and the code you already have.
segments.tr: Glyph 读起来像 TypeScript，只是去掉了逃生口：没有 any，没有类型断言，没有未经校验的数据，每种情况都要处理。它编译为可读的 TypeScript，node、npm 和你现有的代码都照常使用。
需要 Node.js 18 或更高版本

segments.en: examples/apps/csvql is a CSV query engine in this repository, with a Value union at its centre. Before adding a case to it, ask the compiler which places it reaches.
segments.tr: examples/apps/csvql 是本仓库里的一个 CSV 查询引擎，核心是一个 Value 联合类型。给它加一个新 case 之前，先问编译器这会影响到哪些地方。
glyph_variants { name: "Value" }

segments.tr: 然后加上这个 case，运行 glyph check

segments.en: The prediction was right on all eight. The other two, exec::total and render::literal_text, keep compiling and send the new case wherever their catch-all points. An agent that fixes the eight errors and stops has a green build and two live bugs, and the query is what names them.
segments.tr: 预测的八处全部命中。另外两处，exec::total 和 render::literal_text，仍然能编译通过，并把新的 case 交给各自的 catch-all 分支处理。一个修完这八个错误就停手的智能体，会得到一个通过的构建和两个仍然存在的 bug，而指出这两处的正是那次查询。

segments.en: Glyph does not catch everything yet. {{catches:gap-count}} known holes have a reproduction and a gap number, and logic errors pass in Glyph as they do in TypeScript. What it does not catch yet →
